description: Join a specific lot (leave the current lot if any). Triggers a disconnect from the current Lot socket and a new lot-join handshake on the city: `FindLotRequest` → `FindLotResponse` (ticket + host) → connect Aries → `RequestClientSessionResponse(ServiceIdent="JLT")` → `JoinLotWithTransitionRequest`. The city socket is reused; only the lot socket is rebuilt. On success you arrive at `(AvatarLotTilePosX, AvatarLotTilePosY)` facing `AvatarDirection`.
